Exact proofs (UTR and settlement joins) never depended on a fitted threshold, so drift cannot revoke them. Probabilistic verdicts can be — and are, the moment the data stops looking like the calibration.

One severe window warns; two consecutive revoke probabilistic authority. Recovery needs consecutive healthy windows and a new calibration id — quiet alone leaves a threshold that was fitted before the shift. Watch it move: python -m ledger_daemon drift-demo.
